title: NSA certificate for EA280 electronics intelligence course
summary: Jesse Michels tells of NSA certificate for EA280 electronics intelligence course, about early 1990s at NSA complex, Maryland, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this certificate granted to Sherman by the NSA for satisfactory completion of the EA280 intermediate electronics intelligence collection and analysis course.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, interviews Dan Sherman, a former military sergeant who says the NSA, the National Security Agency that handles US electronic spying, hired him to communicate with aliens. Michels shows a certificate he says the NSA gave Sherman in the early 1990s, at its complex in Maryland, for finishing a course called EA280 on collecting and analysing electronic intelligence. It is offered as proof that Sherman really was trained by the agency, which would lend weight to his story.
